title: Custom American Football Close Up on Flag Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this custom American football bedding set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold retro design, this comforter or duvet cover is perfect for football players, fans, and coaches who want to bring the spirit of the game into their daily space.

Key Features

  • Custom Options: Features 2 customizable text inputs to personalize with your chosen name and number.
  • Product Type Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover designed for inserts or a cozy, all-in-one comforter filled with soft microfiber.
  • Material Details: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric for a soft, breathable, and lightweight feel.
  • Available Sizes: Comes in standard US Twin (68x88 in / 68x90 in), Full (78x88 in / 79x90 in), Queen (88x88 in / 90x90 in), and King (104x88 in / 104x90 in).
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and tumble dry on low heat for easy maintenance.
  • Included Components: Includes 1 duvet cover or comforter, with options to add matching pillowcases or an additional flat sheet.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Retro Football
Style Contemporary
Theme Football
Pattern Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
